title: ever NUIT|See-Through Beaded Sheath Round Neck Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant beaded chiffon dress is designed to flatter every figure. The sheer neckline and short sleeves offer soft coverage, while the high-low hemline moves gracefully with every step. Perfect for mothers of the bride or groom, cocktail receptions, and semi-formal evening events?awhere timeless beauty meets effortless comfort.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Side left zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
